title: Receipt
description: A verifier's signed answer to a closed mandate. Mandatory in both directions: a rejection MUST also produce a receipt carrying the error, because a silent failure leaves nothing to reason about in a dispute and is a protocol violation. The error field is present exactly when result is 'error', and carries the same enumeration an RFC 9457 Problem Details response puts in its code extension — so a rejection reads identically whether it is read off the wire or out of the evidence afterwards.

issuer.description: Identifier of the verifier that issued this receipt — the merchant for a Checkout Mandate, the Credential Provider or Merchant Payment Processor for a Payment Mandate.

mandate_type.description: Which kind of closed mandate this receipt answers. AP2 distinguishes a Checkout Receipt from a Payment Receipt by which mandate the reference points at; naming it here is what lets a receipt be routed and audited without first resolving the reference.

reference.description: base64url digest of the closed mandate this receipt answers, computed the way the securing format computes its own presentation digest (AP2: the same algorithm as sd_hash). This is what ties a receipt to exactly one mandate.

error_description.description: Human-readable elaboration of error. For operators, not for machines: nothing may branch on it.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which the verifier issued this receipt.
